pages.quiz:
GEOGRAPHY — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #6
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: GEOGRAPHY
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Action of wind and water in arid areas is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Action of wind and water in arid areas.
   B. Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Action of wind and water in arid areas as rumours only.
   D. Say Action of wind and water in arid areas never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Fishing is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Fishing.
   C. Treat Fishing as rumours only.
   D. Say Fishing never happens in Kenya.

3. Which statement about Elementary Surveying is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Elementary Surveying never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Elementary Surveying.
   C. Treat Elementary Surveying as rumours only.
   D. Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Explain symbols used on a map
   D. Measure rainfall only

5. Which statement about Karst Scenery is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Karst Scenery.
   B. Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Karst Scenery never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Karst Scenery as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Glaciation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Glaciation.
   C. Treat Glaciation as rumours only.
   D. Say Glaciation never happens in Kenya.

7. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Plan income and spending wisely
   C. Ignore prices in shops
   D. Hide all money underground

8. Citizenship responsibility includes: (1 mark)
   A. Obeying laws and caring for public property
   B. Avoiding all community work
   C. Littering in markets
   D. Destroying road signs

9. Which statement about Underground Water is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Underground Water.
   B. Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Underground Water never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Underground Water as rumours only.

10. Which statement about Trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Trade.
   B. Treat Trade as rumours only.
   C. Say Trade never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. Which statement about Statistical Methods is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Statistical Methods as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Statistical Methods.
   C. Say Statistical Methods never happens in Kenya.
   D. Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Mombasa
   B. Nakuru
   C. Kisumu
   D. Nairobi

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Statistical Methods and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Elementary Surveying and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Geographic Information Systems and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Action of wind and water in arid areas and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

1. B — Explain Action of wind and water in arid areas with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

2. A — Explain Fishing with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

3. D — Explain Elementary Surveying with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

4. C — Explain symbols used on a map

5. B — Explain Karst Scenery with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

6. A — Explain Glaciation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

7. B — Plan income and spending wisely

8. A — Obeying laws and caring for public property

9. B — Explain Underground Water with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

10. D — Explain Trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

11. D — Explain Statistical Methods with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.

12. D — Nairobi

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Statistical Methods; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Elementary Surveying; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Geographic Information Systems; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Action of wind and water in arid areas; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
